inputs.text: Wake up, everyone. Do not fall for the official script about the Senior Staff Association of Nigerian Universities (SSANU) issuing a neatly timed one-month ultimatum to the federal government over the long-delayed renegotiation of the 2009 agreement with non-teaching university unions, complete with threats of an indefinite nationwide strike. It is all a grand theatre played out behind the scenes. This synchronized ultimatum, hatched during their 54th National Executive Council, is nothing more than a carefully managed distraction—a staged ritual by the hidden elites pulling the strings of both union leadership and state apparatuses to condition the public and advance their concealed agenda of control. Every delay and every threatened shutdown is a manufactured crisis designed to test compliance.
